description: This PHP script manages role viewing and deletion functionalities for the TestLink project. It initializes page settings, processes role deletion requests with CSRF protection, renders the roles management interface, and defines helper functions for parameter initialization and access rights verification.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and returns the arguments needed for role management page, including role ID, CSRF tokens, and action parameters.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI configuration object with navigation highlights, user grants, role details, and editor type based on the current user session and configuration.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has the 'role_management' right to access the role management page.
